name: Verify
tagline: A functional check of the Next.js output: if this page renders and the chapters move on scroll, the toolchain works.

chapters.title: npm install
chapters.body: Pinned versions, no peer-dependency warnings to silence, no postinstall scripts of our own.

chapters.title: npm run dev
chapters.body: App Router, TypeScript and Tailwind with their default configs; the dev server answers on port 3000.

chapters.title: Mock data
chapters.body: Everything on this page is read from data/*.json, described by schema.json and checked by npm run check:data.

chapters.title: Scroll motion
chapters.body: GSAP ScrollTrigger reveals each chapter as it enters. Reduced motion shows every chapter in place, nothing animates.
